title: docs(driver-memory): re-anchor the dead tracker citations to the commits that decided them (stage 5 of #20595)
body:
Part of #20595
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Stage 5 of the `domain:engine` lane of the dead-citation sweep: `packages/drivers/driver-memory/**`, comment and docblock prose only, per the claim (`5947712781`). Stages 1 to 4 landed as `a7d9768ec`, `d150c3039`, `4bf4e7e70` and `13a24ece2`; #20595 stays open for the next stage.

Every comment or docblock site in the package that cited a tracker number answering 404 is rewritten in ruling C+D's form C (record `5749154545` on #19123): the ADR when one records the decision, otherwise the commit in this repository's history that made it. That is **104 sites on 103 lines in 27 files, covering 13 numbers**:

- **59 census sites** (59 lines, 5 files under `src/`): the whole `allocated-but-absent` population of the gate's own census in this package at the base;
- **4 sites on 3 lines outside the census glob, inside the claimed surface**: `objectstack.config.ts:19` (#11332) and `:26` (#10724), and `tsconfig.typecheck.json:11` (#11332 and #10724 on one `//` line);
- **41 test-comment sites** (41 lines, 20 test files), which the census defers. They carry 11 numbers: 6 the census itself reads as dead in this package's `src`, 2 it reads as dead elsewhere in the repository (#6075, #17590), and 3 it never judges because they stand only in test files (#14434, #16838, #17348), which the board and a single read each settle.

No comment-id citation in the package is dead (see Census).

**Anchors: 13 numbers by commit, 0 by ADR, 0 by words alone.** 11 numbers reuse the anchor another lane or stage already measured for them; 2 were measured here (#14435, #16838). 13 distinct shas. No ADR or ruling record names any of the 13 for this subject: `git grep` over `docs/adr` and `scripts/adr-anchors` finds only ADR-0088's correction row for #10724, which is about `contributes.functions`, not the `contributes.drivers` retirement cited here.

Only comments changed. Every file keeps its line count (103 lines out, 103 in, plus the changeset), so no line citation into any of them moves. No code token moves (the guard below). **No citation number is added**: on every changed line, the numbers on the new text are a subset of those on the old, and the diff-scoped gate judged the 7 citations left on changed lines: all 7 resolve.

**A `patch` changeset**: 20 of the 62 rewritten non-test lines are in the published `dist` (the `.d.ts` keeps JSDoc on exported members, and esbuild keeps some comments in the JS), and `dist` is not byte-identical with the base text (see Changeset).

| after | `17f667f86`, run 08:13:08Z to 08:17:18Z | enumerated, 192 pages, frontier #21370, 19,191 records (newest before and after: #21370) | 271 | **0** | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The whole-repo drop is 59, and the two finding sets differ by exactly the 59 rows of this package, removed; none was added. `resolves` (34,880), `resolves-as-pull-request` (2,378) and `cross-repo-unjudged` (1,165) did not move. The card's 62 was taken at `f11b5f20a2` with the older extractor; the base here reads 59. The head's later commits are the changeset (outside the census surface) and one merge of `main` that touches no file under `packages/drivers/driver-memory`.

**Supplementary instrument, the whole package.** The census reads neither test files nor strings nor files outside `src`. A second reading runs the gate's own exported `extractCitations` (whole-file and comment-prose projections) over every tracked file in the package (89: 82 `.ts`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.typecheck.json`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`, `objectstack.config.ts` among the `.ts`), and classifies each citation with the gate's `classifyCitation` against one board enumerated by the gate's `enumerateBoard` (192 pages, frontier #21369, 19,190 records, 07:59:39Z to 08:03:13Z). Every one of the 13 numbers in the population was then read on its own over the issues endpoint (08:04Z): **all 13 answer 404**, and the lit controls `#5286` and `#12624` answer 200.

| reading | citations | dead | src comment | test comment | other (`tsconfig.typecheck.json`) | test string | changelog |

`src comment` here is the 59 census sites plus the 2 in `objectstack.config.ts`. The drop of 104 citations is exactly the rewritten sites, and the live counts did not move (src comment: 494 resolve, 13 as pull requests, 1 cross-repo; test comment: 504, 20 and 4). A third, raw reading (every `#` followed by 2 to 6 digits, whatever surrounds it) counts 1,736 before and 1,632 after: a drop of 104.

**Comment ids.** Three distinct comment-id citations stand on 6 sites in this package: `5234868334` (1 site), `5861435168` (2) and `5865693155` (3). Each was read over the issue-comments endpoint and answers 200 (control `5947712781`, 200). So no comment id is in the population.

## Per-number table

`src` counts the census sites plus the four outside the census glob; `test` counts test-comment sites. Every sha below matches exactly one commit (`git rev-parse --disambiguate`, count 1) and is an ancestor of the base `5fd4855a9` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0 for all 13 shas; the clone is not shallow). The `+` lines introduce exactly these 13 nine-hex spans and no other. The message or the diff of each one names the number it replaces: 6 in the message and the diff (`56c093c4d`, `0f38ab084`, `9dac1ae01`, `be21955ba`, `e04a0aff2`, `d367f03d6`), 6 in the diff alone (`555a89cbd` 28 added lines, `20950404c` 7, `dce5cd4f0` 26, `51efbf116` 4, `20032594f` 8, `b90aff81f` 9), and 1 only in the subject's squash suffix (`93940d492`, where #14434 was that pull request's own number). Each anchor touches `packages/drivers/driver-memory` itself, except `e04a0aff2`, whose two sites name the `driver-sql` fixture it created. `git blame` at the base puts 67 of the 104 sites on their anchor. The other 37 were written by a different commit that cites the number as another change: for #13197, the declared-index commit `b7f645a8a` and the atomicity commits `34e80993f` and `4642f4c64`; for #13195, the clobber generalisation `df1812050`, the reference-matcher retirement `8fec76a2b`, and two commits from while that card was open (`178325bcb`, `9268aec56`, see Wordings to check). In each case the anchor is the commit that made the change the sentence credits to the number. `source` says whether another lane or stage already used this anchor for this number (`reused`) or it was measured here (`measured`).

## Wordings to check

Most rewrites swap a tag in place (`[#N]` to `[commit SHA]`, `(#N)` to `(commit SHA)`, `#N's X` to `commit SHA's X`, `since #N` to `since commit SHA`), the form the landed stages use. These say more than the tag:

- **`#17348`** (`memory-driver-filter-logic-conformance.test.ts:598`): 「the repair is in the driver, and it is #17348's, filed」 became 「the repair is in the driver, named as owed in commit 51efbf116 and filed」, with `:599` (「against #5499's investment freeze.」) untouched. `51efbf116` wrote this note, and its changeset records 「That divergence is filed as #17348 and pinned by name」.
- **`#13195` where it was written while that card was open** (`memory-matcher-no-value-negated-operators.test.ts:32`): the sentence says `$exists` 「is the neighbouring cell」 and 「still read[s] it as key-presence」, and `:47` already calls that caution history. A bare swap would credit `9dac1ae01` with a still-open divergence, so it reads 「(the card commit 9dac1ae01 closed)」. The other site written while that card was open, `memory-exists-has-value-faces.test.ts:4`, is the file's title from the pin `9268aec56` took before the fix; the header under it says the file 「is no longer a pin of a divergence」 but was inverted in place, and `9dac1ae01` is the commit that inverted it, so a tag swap reads true there.
- **A quotation of this note's own earlier text** (`memory-driver-document-not.test.ts:239`-`:241`, 「It used to say "… the direction is now #13166's and #13195's to settle."」): the dead number inside the quote became a bracketed editorial substitution, 「[commit 9dac1ae01]'s」, so the quote stays recognisable as a quote and says where the edit is. It is the note quoting itself, not a ruling.
- **Where the number named the defect, not the change**: 「(this is the #16589 defect)」 became 「(this is the defect commit 555a89cbd fixed)」 (`memory-tenancy-guard.ts:271`); 「This is the #16589 answer」 became 「This is the defect's answer (fixed in commit 555a89cbd)」 (`memory-tenant-scope-refusal.test.ts:139`); and in that file's reading table (`:29`) the cell 「the #16589 defect」 became 「what commit 555a89cbd fixed」, which fits the column's 28-character width, so the table stays aligned and no row is added.
- **Slash and list pairs**: 「#13197/#13239」 became 「commit 56c093c4d and #13239」 (two sites); 「#13197 / #13239」 became 「commit 56c093c4d / #13239」; 「[#13197, #13239]」 became 「[commit 56c093c4d, #13239]」 (four sites); 「(#11332 / #10724 / #4914)」 became 「(commit dce5cd4f0 / commit be21955ba / #4914)」, the exact form the eleven-package sweep (`aaad682dbc`) gave the same sentence in `plugin-hono-server`.
- **`driver-sql`'s fixture** (`memory-20874-contains-membership.test.ts:63`, `:110`): 「`driver-sql`'s #17590 fixture」 / 「assertions」 became 「`driver-sql`'s commit e04a0aff2 fixture」 / 「assertions」; `e04a0aff2` created `sql-driver-17590-json-column-membership.test.ts`.
- **Dated rulings keep their date**: the `#13195` sites that say 「ruled … 2026-08-30」 keep it (`9dac1ae01`'s changeset and docblocks carry 「the maintainer ruled on 2026-08-30」).
- **Capitalisation**: where the number opened a sentence, the new text opens with 「Commit」 (five sites).
- No line was reflowed, so some are longer than their block's wrap (`eslint.config.mjs` declares no line-length rule, and a reflow would move neighbouring lines and every line citation into the file).

## Sites left

- **In comments (src, test, the two config files): none.**
- **String literals: 21 test-string sites, 7 numbers, 11 files** (`describe` and `it` titles, assertion arguments): `#13195` 7, `#13197` 7, `#11065` 2, `#16838` 2, `#14435` 1, `#16589` 1, `#16729` 1. Every one of the 7 is in this stage's population, so the table above holds an anchor for each. Non-test strings carry none. Strings are outside this stage's surface.
- **Outside `src`:** the release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` names dead numbers on 18 sites (11 numbers); left. `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `README.md` and `LICENSE` cite no dead number.

## Mechanical guard: no code token moves

The guard (stages 2 to 4's) compares base `5fd4855a9` against the working tree over all 27 touched files, with TypeScript 6.0.3 (`tsconfig.typecheck.json` through `ts.parseJsonText`, the same two walks):

- **Reading 1**: the parser's leaf nodes, from a `forEachChild` walk. Comments are trivia there, and JSDoc is never visited. A leaf that is not itself a token is re-scanned with trivia skipped.
- **Reading 2**: the full token stream in parser context, from a `getChildren` walk, JSDoc nodes skipped. String, template and numeric literals are compared in full on both readings.

Results:

- Real run at the head: 61,808 base tokens, **0 files with a token change** (exit 0).
- Comment control (「The declaration dies with the table.」 to 「DIES」, `memory-driver.ts`): 0 files changed (exit 0).
- Positive control, an identifier (`tenantFieldOf` to `tenantFieldOfX`, `memory-unique-constraint.ts`): DIFFER on both readings (exit 1).
- Positive control, a string literal (`'MEMORY_MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED'` to `…X`, `memory-tenancy-guard.ts`): DIFFER on both readings (exit 1).
- Positive control, a numeric literal (`UNIQUE_VIOLATION_STATUS = 409` to `410`, `memory-unique-constraint.ts`): DIFFER on both readings (exit 1).
- Positive control, a JSON value (`"rootDir": "."` to `"./"`, `tsconfig.typecheck.json`): DIFFER on both readings (exit 1).

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, anchor hit 1 to 0) under a shell trap that restores by absolute path from `HEAD`. Each restore was proven equal to its `HEAD` blob (`ac823bf8fa9b`, `eb0eb11358ea`, `7b008c1f12b7`, `eb0eb11358ea`, `88035b359542`), with `git diff HEAD` empty and a clean tree afterwards.

## Changeset: `patch` (`dist` measured)

`files[]` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and the package is not private. The dependency closure and the package were built first (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/driver-memory^...' --filter=@objectstack/driver-memory`, 5 of 5 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0). Then the package's own `build` (tsup plus `check-dts-emitted`) ran three times in one script under the shared verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), at `17f667f86`:

- **Leg 1**, the head text: 6 `dist` files hashed. Of the 62 rewritten non-test lines, 20 appear verbatim in `dist`: 11 from `memory-driver.ts`, 4 each from `memory-tenancy-guard.ts` and `memory-unique-constraint.ts`, 1 from `memory-analytics.ts`; in `index.d.ts` / `index.d.mts` (16) and `index.js` / `index.mjs` (10).
- **Leg 2**, the base text put back in the 7 non-test touched files (7 of 7 proven equal to their base blob): 4 of the 6 files differ from leg 1 (`index.d.ts`, `index.d.mts`, `index.js`, `index.mjs`), and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` finds the base marker 「[#16729] One driver's record」 in 2 built files (exit 0).
- **Leg 3**, after the proven restore (7 of 7 equal to their `HEAD` blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, porcelain empty): all 6 files are byte-identical to leg 1, and the preflight's `--absent` reading exits 0, so the build is deterministic and the difference is the rewrite.

So the rewrite ships, and `.changeset/20595-driver-memory-provenance-anchors.md` declares a `patch` for `@objectstack/driver-memory`, comment text only, with the claim's `Clause-②: no` line. The later changeset commit and the merge of `main` touch no file under `packages/drivers/driver-memory`.

## Gates (head `381dddc9c`)

- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `381dddc9c` (28 paths against merge base `fbe2debb7`, 220 changed lines) derived 62 commands. All 62 ran, each exit code captured before any pipe: 62 exit 0. `--ran` reports 「62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN」 (a derived zero) and exits 0.
- **Roster families the derivation flags under a touched directory**, also run, each exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `pnpm check:authz-resolver`, `pnpm check:error-code-casing`, `pnpm check:filter-alias-parity`, `pnpm check:object-def-param-keys`, `pnpm check:tenant-chokepoint`.
- **Named readings:** `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` exits 0 (「every citation this change adds resolves」, 7 judged across 5 files); `pnpm check:issue-citations` exits 0 (self-test, 173 cases, 9 batteries); `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exits 0 (the sibling-package prose-id baseline holds, no growth); `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exits 0 (9,669 files, no raw control bytes), and a control-byte grep over the 28 changed files finds none (exit 1).
- **Build before the gates:** `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*' --concurrency=2` at `381dddc9c`, 71 of 71 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Tests and typecheck, under the verify lock, at `381dddc9c`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-memory test`: 70 test files pass (70), 1,718 tests pass (1,718), exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-memory typecheck` (both programs, `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.typecheck.json`) exits 0. `tsc --listFiles` puts all 70 tracked test files and the 25 changed `src` files in the `tsconfig.json` program, and `objectstack.config.ts` in the `tsconfig.typecheck.json` one.
- **Lint, as a proven narrowing:** eslint with inline config disabled, over the 26 touched `.ts` files plus `dist/index.js` as the control: 27 results, 0 errors and 1 warning, the control's ignore notice; none of the 26 is reported ignored. `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its lines 327-328 say so), so a comment edit cannot move the verdict on an untouched file. `tsconfig.typecheck.json` is not an eslint target (run alone, eslint answers 「File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied」); the token guard covers it. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
